description: Characters and voice actors for a title, or look up a character/VA by name. Provide "id" for title → cast lookup, or "character_name" / "voice_actor_name" for name-based lookup. Returns characters with their role, voice actors by language, and cross-links to other media.

character_name.description: Character name to search for. Returns the character's appearances across media. Trimmed; blank counts as absent. Send exactly one of id, character_name, or voice_actor_name.

full_text.description: Render complete domain JSON in text, including full biography and every role on this page. Default false uses bounded summaries; upstream pagination is unchanged.

id.description: AniList media ID for title → cast lookup. Use anime_search_media to find this ID. Send exactly one of id, character_name, or voice_actor_name.

language.description: Filter voice actors by language. Common: JAPANESE, ENGLISH, KOREAN. Only with id (title → cast lookup); rejected with a name search.

voice_actor_name.description: Voice actor/staff name to search for. Returns their roles across anime. Trimmed; blank counts as absent. Send exactly one of id, character_name, or voice_actor_name.

name: anime_find_characters

cap.description: The per-page limit applied. Present alongside truncated.

characters.description: Characters found. In by_media mode, characters for the title. In by_character mode, one character with their media appearances as context. Empty in by_voice_actor mode.

items.description: A character entry with voice actor list.

character_name_native.description: Native script character name, or null.

character_site_url.description: AniList character page URL, or null.

media_format.description: Media format for this appearance. Present in by_character mode.

media_id.description: AniList media ID for this appearance. Present in by_character mode.

media_title.description: Romanized media title for this appearance. Present in by_character mode.

role.description: Role in the media: MAIN, SUPPORTING, or BACKGROUND.

voice_actor_data_available.description: False when the provider did not supply actor data; true for populated or genuinely empty lists.

voice_actors.description: Voice actors for this character, filtered by language if requested.

items.description: A voice actor for this character.

va_name_native.description: Native script VA name, or null.

va_site_url.description: AniList VA page URL, or null.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: Name search returns no match from AniList. `media_not_found`: AniList has no media record for the requested ID. `missing_identifier`: None of id, a non-blank character_name, or a non-blank voice_actor_name is provided. `conflicting_inputs`: More than one of id / character_name / voice_actor_name is provided, or language without id. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

full_text.description: Whether text renders the complete domain result as JSON.

has_next_page.description: Whether more results are available on the next page.

media_id.description: AniList media ID used for the lookup, or null for name-based lookup.

notice.description: Next-page guidance. Present in by_media mode only when the cast list was capped.

shown.description: Number of characters returned. Present alongside truncated.

truncated.description: True when the cast list was capped at per_page. Present in by_media mode only, and only when the cap was hit.

description.description: Normalized full bio/description text, or null.

roles.description: Media roles for this voice actor.

items.description: A media role entry for this voice actor.

va_name_native.description: Native script VA name, or null.

va_site_url.description: AniList VA page URL, or null.

voice_actor.description: Voice actor detail (populated in by_voice_actor mode only, null otherwise).

title: Anime Find Characters
